why: A class-folder file kids.m that holds no method kids (Octave, help text, empty) is what MATLAB finds for the name, so the guessed call in the class folder's code is blocked; deleting it or making it a real method relinks it, and a sync ends where a fresh index ends. The file goes from Octave to nothing, a method, help text, empty and a method; an empty file added where none was, while the guess stands, is S11-class-folders-1 (step 9, reopenMatlabScriptRuns; truth harvested from matlab-dispatch.test.ts 'when an Octave file of the name is in the class folder').
